sinopsis.es: Itzia es una mujer sorda que asegura haber comenzado a escuchar una música peculiar que siempre proviene del mismo punto cardinal. En su pueblo creen que está enloqueciendo e intentan convencerla de ir al médico. Para demostrar que no está loca, deberá emprender un viaje en busca de la fuente de la música.
sinopsis.en: Itzia is a deaf woman who claims to have started hearing a peculiar music that always comes from the same cardinal point. In her village, people believe she is going crazy and try to convince her to see a doctor. To prove she is not crazy, she will have to embark on a journey to find the source of the music.
